title: Appointed as Assistant
original: The files are in order. Is that all we have to do today? Good, then why don't we talk about the operation the other day, Professor?

title: Talk 1
original: Try not to come too close when I use Arts, okay? ... You won't? Whatever suits you then.

title: Talk 2
original: Why am I calling you 'Professor'? Because I'm actually learning quite a lot from you: where to assign personnel on the battlefield, how to command, among many other things… What more reason do we need?

title: Talk 3
original: Here, you can have this. Some sort of candy, I think. No need to thank me. I got it from someone else anyway. Couldn't care less.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Sankta using staves is a rare sight to see, you say? Those fanatics on a non-stop shooting spree must have left you with a bad impression with their 'pews' and 'bangs.' Not all Sankta use guns as their weapons. At the very least, I don't like them.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Rather than sharing a single secret, we should exchange our secrets with each other. That's how you build a strong, equal relationship. So if you want to learn any of my secrets, you better come up with something just as saucy for me, Professor.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: There are no Infected in Laterano. Once a Sankta contracts Oripathy, he is immediately exiled. But even if you become Infected, no matter where you are, you still enjoy all kinds of privilege as a Laterano... You just don't get to set foot in your homeland again, that's all.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: My parents' will left me with quite a bit of trouble, and it was really a hassle to get it taken care of. If it wasn't for that uptight executor making things difficult for me, it all could've been much easier... Oh, whatever, it still went according to my plan.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I want to capture a few people to try out some new Arts in our next operation. I can't...? Alright, fine. It's a shame, but if that's what you say, Professor, maybe some other time, then. Eh? Not this time, and not ever? Geez, don't be so uptight.

title: Idle
original: Are you asleep? People who fall asleep at work get their faces drawn on, you know...? Just kidding, I know you're awake.

title: Onboard
original: Codename Arene, officially joining today, it seems. So you are the Doctor... I hope we'll get along, Professor {@nickname}.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Studying tactics? Sounds kinda interesting.

title: Promotion 1
original: This doesn't seem all that different than before. Or are you going to teach me some tricks of the trade, Professor?

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, you aren't testing me, are you? Alright then, I'm just getting in the mood. Okay, starting right now, whatever happens is going to be our own little secret.

title: Added to Squad
original: Okay, I'll follow your orders.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: So actual combat for my next assignment? Okay, let me think about the deployment...

title: Depart
original: As long as we achieve our goals, it doesn't matter if the process is a little rough, huh?

title: Begin Operation
original: Welcome. I've been waiting.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: My turn?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: No need to rush.

title: Deployment 1
original: Not a bad position.

title: Deployment 2
original: I can do whatever I want, right?

title: In Battle 1
original: I've given my warning.

title: In Battle 2
original: Does it hurt?

title: In Battle 3
original: Tell me. How are you feeling right now?

title: In Battle 4
original: That's not a bad scream at all.

title: 4-star Result
original: That went far better than I expected. I shouldn't have thought so little of you, Professor.

title: 3-star Result
original: That was just as expected. No surprises, even a little boring.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: A few slipped past. Should I go after them? Strategically speaking, I don't recommend it.

title: Operation Failure
original: This is quite the bad situation... You know what the appropriate course of action is now, right?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Isn't there a closer room to the Professor's?

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: We have some time to spare. Why don't we review our last mission, Professor?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Professor, I've learned a new trick. You can come closer this time. It's not dangerous. Put this piece of metal on your hand, then just very lightly... Look, it turned into a small firework. How about that? It's just as good as the noisy ones outside, right?

title: Greeting
original: You look tired. It's okay if you sleep a little longer, Professor.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Prof. {@nickname}. As you can see, I'm not too fond of overly complicated ceremonies. I hope you're not so into loud parties, either, since I'm planning to celebrate in more meaningful ways with you. Right, I mean just the two of us.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Professor, when you steer Rhodes Island, what do you weigh and consider? Enemies, friends, what we need to do, what we mustn't do... There has to be a line that we cannot cross so that we don't lose ourselves. Am I right? I see...
